title: Sheep in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='34' y='72' width='7' height='16' rx='3' fill='#4a4a5a'/>
  <rect x='59' y='72' width='7' height='16' rx='3' fill='#4a4a5a'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='32' y='84' width='11' height='6' rx='3' fill='#2e2e3e'/>
  <rect x='57' y='84' width='11' height='6' rx='3' fill='#2e2e3e'/>
  <!-- body wool (cloud-like) -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='22' fill='#f2f0e8'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='52' r='13' fill='#f2f0e8'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='52' r='13' fill='#f2f0e8'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='43' r='12' fill='#f7f5ef'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='43' r='12' fill='#f7f5ef'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='12' fill='#f7f5ef'/>
  <!-- scarf around neck -->
  <path d='M36 62 Q50 70 64 62 L64 68 Q50 76 36 68 Z' fill='#e84a5f'/>
  <!-- scarf tail -->
  <path d='M62 66 L72 78 L66 80 L58 68 Z' fill='#e84a5f'/>
  <path d='M64 76 L70 76 L68 80 L62 80 Z' fill='#ff8a9a'/>
  <!-- head wool -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='16' fill='#f7f5ef'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='26' r='9' fill='#f2f0e8'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='26' r='9' fill='#f2f0e8'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='31' cy='28' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#d9c9b8' transform='rotate(-20 31 28)'/>
  <ellipse cx='69' cy='28' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#d9c9b8' transform='rotate(20 69 28)'/>
  <!-- face -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='12' ry='10' fill='#e8d8c8'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='30' r='2.5' fill='#2e2e3e'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='30' r='2.5' fill='#2e2e3e'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='29' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='29' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose/mouth -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#c47a7a'/>
  <path d='M47 40 Q50 42 53 40' stroke='#8a5a5a' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='36' r='3' fill='#f0a0a0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='36' r='3' fill='#f0a0a0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- wool tuft on top -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='16' r='6' fill='#f7f5ef'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='19' r='5' fill='#f2f0e8'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='19' r='5' fill='#f2f0e8'/>
</svg>
